Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ai

Class AiSummarizationAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ai.AiSummarizationAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AiSummarizationPort
@Component public class AiSummarizationAdapter extends Object implements AiSummarizationPort
Spring AI adapter that implements AiSummarizationPort using a large-language model (LLM) via Spring AI's ChatClient.

What Spring AI's ChatClient does

ChatClient is Spring AI's unified, provider-agnostic HTTP client for talking to LLMs. You build a prompt (a structured text request), send it with .call(), and receive the model's text response. The same code works whether the underlying model is Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, or any other provider — you switch models purely through application.properties, with zero Java code changes.

Spring Boot auto-configures a ChatClient.Builder bean based on whichever provider starter is on the classpath (e.g. spring-ai-starter-model-anthropic). This adapter receives that builder via constructor injection and calls .build() once to produce the reusable ChatClient instance.

How the adapter bridges domain and AI

The domain layer knows nothing about AI — it defines only the AiSummarizationPort interface with plain Java types (NewsArticle, NewsletterSection, etc.). This adapter sits in the infrastructure layer and is the only class in the project that imports Spring AI. It:

  1. Converts domain objects into a plain-text prompt string.
  2. Sends the prompt to the LLM via ChatClient.
  3. Parses the model's plain-text response back into domain objects.

Prompt templates

Prompt text is loaded from /prompts/summarize-articles.txt and /prompts/generate-introduction.txt on the classpath. Keeping prompts in resource files (rather than hard-coded strings) makes them easy to tune without recompiling. Placeholders like {topic} are replaced at runtime by this class.

Response parsing

The summarize prompt instructs the model to reply in a strict two-line format: 

 HEADLINE: <text>
 SUMMARY: <text>
This class parses that format with a simple loop. A more robust approach (structured output via JSON schema) can be introduced in a later slice without changing the port interface.

Unit testing without real AI calls

Because this adapter implements a port interface, unit tests never instantiate it. Instead, they inject a Mockito mock of AiSummarizationPort. Real calls to the LLM happen only in smoke tests annotated with @ActiveProfiles("ai-integration").

    • AiSummarizationAdapter

      public AiSummarizationAdapter(org.springframework.ai.chat.client.ChatClient.Builder chatClientBuilder, PromptLoaderService promptLoaderService)
      Constructs the adapter and builds the shared ChatClient.

      Spring Boot injects ChatClient.Builder automatically based on the provider starter present on the classpath. No API key wiring is needed here — credentials are read from application.properties (or environment variables) by the auto-configuration.

      Parameters:
      chatClientBuilder - Auto-configured builder provided by Spring AI.
      promptLoaderService - Service that resolves prompt templates from the external filesystem directory or classpath fallback.

  • Method Details

    • summarize

      public NewsletterSection summarize(List<NewsArticle> articles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId)
      Summarize a set of articles covering the same topic into a single newsletter section.

      Implementation detail: assembles a prompt that includes each article's title and body text, instructs the model on tone, then parses the two-line HEADLINE / SUMMARY response format into a NewsletterSection.

      Specified by:
      summarize in interface AiSummarizationPort
      Parameters:
      articles - Source articles to summarize; must not be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by all articles; used to focus the prompt.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection with an AI-generated headline and summary.

    • summarizeWithTemplate

      public NewsletterSection summarizeWithTemplate(List<NewsArticle> articles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId, String templateText)
      Summarize a set of articles using a caller-provided prompt template instead of the default template. Used by the prompt evaluation framework to experiment with different prompt variants.

      Implementation detail: identical to summarize(java.util.List<com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsArticle>, java.lang.String, com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsletterTone, java.lang.String) but uses the caller-provided templateText instead of loading from the classpath. Placeholders in the template are substituted with the same values as the default flow.

      Specified by:
      summarizeWithTemplate in interface AiSummarizationPort
      Parameters:
      articles - Source articles to summarize; must not be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by all articles.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      templateText - Custom prompt template text with placeholders.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection with an AI-generated headline and summary.

    • summarizeWithContext

      public NewsletterSection summarizeWithContext(List<NewsArticle> articles, List<NewsArticle> contextArticles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId)
      Summarize fresh articles for a topic, enriched with semantically similar past articles retrieved from the vector store (retrieval-augmented generation).

      The contextArticles list is used only to provide historical perspective in the prompt — they are not treated as the primary source material and are not included in the returned section's article ID list.

      Implementation detail: builds a RAG-enhanced prompt using summarize-articles-rag.txt, which includes both a fresh-articles block and a related-past-context block. The context articles provide historical perspective only; they are not listed in the returned section's article ID attribution.

      Specified by:
      summarizeWithContext in interface AiSummarizationPort
      Parameters:
      articles - Fresh articles for this topic; must not be empty.
      contextArticles - Past articles retrieved via RAG; may be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by the fresh articles.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection whose headline and summary incorporate both fresh and historical context.

      public String generateTopicSummary(String topic, List<NewsArticle> articles)
      Generate a concise 3-sentence summary of the given articles for a topic section on the news listing page.

      Uses only article titles (not full body text) to keep token cost low. The returned string is plain text — no headline, no bullet points.

      Implementation detail: builds a lightweight prompt using only article titles (not full body text) to minimize token cost. Returns the model's response directly as a plain-text string.

      Specified by:
